seo.title: Workloom — Team Task Management and Weekly Planning
seo.description: Bring tasks, weekly plans, recorded work, team meetings and dependencies into one connected workspace.

hero.eyebrow: A little more clarity. Every week.
hero.title: Give every week a clear thread.
hero.description: Connect the tasks ahead with the work that actually happens. Keep owners, weekly plans, meetings and dependencies in view, together.
hero.note: Tasks, plans and recorded work, connected.

example.label: An illustrative workspace
example.planDescription: Choose the work you want to take on.
example.factDescription: Keep actual work alongside the plan.
example.connection: Dependencies keep the next step in context.
example.caption: Illustration with example tasks. Your workspace starts with your own work.

features.title: Less piecing things together. More shared understanding.
features.description: Move between the details of a task and the shape of the week without losing the context.

tasks.title: Make the next step clear.
tasks.description: Keep tasks, owners, statuses and dates together. Use the table or board to find the work that needs attention.

planning.title: Give the week an honest picture.
planning.description: Set personal weekly plans and record work against tasks. Compare the plan with what was actually recorded.

meetings.title: Keep meetings in the picture.
meetings.description: Bring scheduled meetings, personal plans and recorded attendance into the same weekly context.

dependencies.title: See what comes before what.
dependencies.description: Connect tasks across projects, see unfinished predecessors and explore the graph or dated timeline.

how.title: From a task to a clearer week.

one.title: Lay out the work.
one.description: Create a project, add tasks and make ownership clear. Connect the tasks that depend on one another.

two.title: Make room for the week.
two.description: Choose personal commitments in an explicit weekly period, with meetings in the same context.

three.title: Keep the picture honest.
three.description: Record work and review plan versus fact. Use the context to decide what comes next.

closing.title: A clearer view of the work ahead.
closing.description: Bring your tasks and your week into one workspace.

footer.note: A connected workspace for tasks, plans and recorded work.
